fields.finding: Unvented P2 honeycomb would retain about 43.388 kg of ambient air. P3 tube bores would retain about 88.153/76.110 kg. Base cases require these spaces to share the evacuation path. Trapped gas is onboard mass even before it leaks into the main cavity.
fields.proposed_next: Establish and qualify internal vent paths, pressure equalization and residual gas inventory. Any geometric vent change requires structural review.
